Creatures: LvlSiren (Starfield.esm, VeryAggressive), found 11-02 by gen_inspect. Lore (fandom): armoured, long-eared predators, native to Lantana VIII-b, brought to Niira by the UC Xenowarfare Division in the Colony War. Said once, in the briefing, as fact.

place._planet: STAND-IN: not in the closed planet table (only Akila). Eliza's to add.

prose.name: Hunt: Siren Pack on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A Siren pack has been working the ground around the <Place>, descended from the ones the UC brought to Niira as weapons in the war. The site wants the pack drawn in and finished.
prose.card: Settlement Contract. Bait and hunt the Siren pack at the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on contract completion.

broadcast: They won't come at you on open ground, they're too clever for that. Put the bait out at the centre and wait. When they come, they come together.

beats.name: Bait Crate
beats.journal: I set the bait out at the <Place>. Now I need to hold the site when the Sirens come for it.
say: Bait's out. They'll smell it long before they see you, so stay ready.

beats.objective: Hold off the Siren pack at the <Place>
beats.journal: The Siren pack came for the bait at the <Place>, and I put every one of them down.
say: That's the whole pack. Nothing's been working that ground but us now.
